title: Build it the standard linear way
purpose: Research, plan, build, test, ship: one system built with a coding agent, each phase proven before the next.
why: The default process for building with an agent. Deciding before building, proving each piece, and leaving a record someone else can follow is what reviewers look for in a take-home and what teams look for in a hire.
evidence: The repo: research note, plan, one commit per working piece, iteration log, README.

modules.title: The standard linear agentic development process

tasks.title: Research: rules checklist, constraints with numbers, options compared
tasks.done_when: A research note in the repo lists every rule in the brief, the time and money limits, the options you compared and your sources.

tasks.title: Plan in one context and answer what could go wrong
tasks.done_when: The plan names each piece, its order, the check that proves it and what is left out, and you can explain it without the agent.

tasks.title: Build one proven piece at a time
tasks.done_when: Each piece has its own commit and a check you can run.

tasks.title: Test somewhere safe first, keep an iteration log
tasks.done_when: Every line of the checklist passes and the log shows what you saw, why, and what you changed.

tasks.title: Ship it readable
tasks.done_when: A stranger can run it from the README, follow your decisions, and find every required item.
